def: A repeated cycle of proposing a change, measuring it and keeping or discarding it, run without a human between iterations.
Karpathy's repository in which an agent edits train.py, trains for five minutes and keeps the change only if validation bits per byte improve.
The plain-English instruction file that tells the agent how to set up and run the experiment loop.
Validation bits per byte: the model's cross-entropy on held-out text converted to bits and divided by bytes, so that models with different tokenisers can be compared.
The decision rule that keeps a change if its score beats the best so far and undoes it otherwise.
A program described by the states it can be in and the events that move it between them.
A limit on elapsed real time for a run, rather than on steps or tokens.
The set of files and resources a proposer is allowed to change; the evaluator should sit outside it.
The tab-separated log of the loop with one row per run: commit, val_bpb, memory, status and description.
